slots.visualRecipe: Pure white ground, one hero term typing at centre, about 55% of frame width, ink #1D221E-class near-black. Then two overhead lifestyle photographs (hands with devices, warm daylight): on the first a white rounded query bar about 43% wide at y 0.47 continues the line; on the second the line continues as two outline chips either side of the photographed object. End state: the object at frame centre, about 5% wide.
slots.motionRecipe: Typewriter at 2-3 frames a character with a thin caret, no tween. Hard cuts at 0.57 s and 1.33 s; the line keeps typing across them. Exit: the object glows and grows slightly on its screen over the last 5 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it). Opening section is the quietest; keep the first 3 s sparse.

copySlot.purpose: an open question about the effort the subject needed

slots.role: reveal the subject through an object
slots.visualRecipe: Match cut: the object becomes a glossy 3D sphere on a dark green ground (near-black to forest green), same place and size. Two small words either side turn it into a term in a line. The sphere then fills the frame and its colour becomes the ground; the mark sits at centre, then the name appears beside it, bold italic, about 53% of frame width.
slots.motionRecipe: Words type in 1-2 frames after the match cut. Hold 1.3 s. Words fade in 1-2 frames; sphere grows from 10% of width to past the edges in 8 frames on circ.in. Mark slides left as the name wipes in from beneath it over 4 frames. Hold 0.6 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it).

copySlot.purpose: two-term descriptor flanking the object, then the subject's name

slots.role: proof: the actual deliverable, then its device
slots.visualRecipe: Three overexposed mint-white frames, then the actual deliverable (a captured page) full frame; its headline fades in; then it sits on a monitor on a lit sweep tinted in the accent colour (light mint top, deep green floor).
slots.motionRecipe: Bloom 3 frames; pixelated resolve 8-10 frames; headline fade 5 frames; pull-back to about 47% scale in 0.46 s on power3.out (bezier 0.46, 0.76, 0.16, 0.83). Hold to end.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it).

slots.role: chapter title and the system itself
slots.visualRecipe: Accent gradient (signal green top to lime bottom). White chip with the chapter label, left-placed, chip about 17% of frame height; palette dots; a round arrow icon; a dark pill with the second term. Then a slowly turning glossy 3D fan render full frame, a right column of tiles (photo over type specimen) and a large lower-case glyph filling its tile in the accent lime on near-black.
slots.motionRecipe: Chip grows from a white rectangle; icon turns in 1 frame; pill pops in 3 frames with overshoot; layout drifts left on power2.in. Hard cut to the fan; column slides in from the right in 4 frames; glyph grows to fill its tile in 4 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it).

slots.role: dense collage around a still hero
slots.visualRecipe: Bento on black or near-black: counter tile, photo of a device in a hand, dark tiles with small icons. Then one people photo full frame under a pastel haze, snapping to a centred tile about 63% wide; 6-8 tiles fill around it with thin gutters (photos, lime tile, colour-bar tile, counter chips, tall side panels). End state: full bento, hero still at centre.
slots.motionRecipe: Each tile cuts on fully formed in 1-2 frames, no tween; counters step each frame for about 13 frames; side panels enter from the edges in 1 frame. Haze clears and the frame eases back (circ.out) before the snap.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it).

copySlot.purpose: short figures on tiles, no sentences

slots.visualRecipe: White design-tool canvas: thin selection box with handles, a caret, named cursor tags in small coloured flags. A three-term line in a small grotesque at centre; page parts (header bar, 3D render at right, a sample module at lower left) arrive around it. After the retype, the frame is so tight the headline overflows both edges; header links, a tilted action button and 3D glyph renders fall in.
slots.motionRecipe: Type a word every 5 frames; hold 40 frames; backspace about 2.1 characters a frame; 6 empty frames; retype the actual headline a word every 3.4 frames over two lines; punch in over 8 frames (power1.inOut) until it overflows; parts fall into place over 1 s while the frame drifts left.
slots.soundRecipe: Music bed only, no voice; do not cut to the beat grid (the original's changes sit at chance against it). A quiet section ends near 19.5 s in the original; let the assembly start in the lull.

copySlot.purpose: a question to the viewer, then a short action line

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid: tempo confidence 0.58 with an ambiguous beat level and the corrected changes at chance against the beats (26% vs 27%). Alternate long assembly shots of 2-5 s, where the motion happens inside the shot (typing 1-2 characters a frame, tiles cutting on in 1-2 frames, counters stepping each frame), with stutter runs of 0.3-0.6 s holds. Target about 42 changes in 57 s, median hold 1.0 s, p10 0.4 s, p90 2.6 s. Change grounds on cuts, and keep any typed line typing across them.

style: Light and green: lime, signal green and forest green with white and near-black; one geometric grotesque in sentence case; lifestyle photos, glossy renders and actual captures, either one centred object on a flat ground or a dense tiled collage around a held centre.

keep: Show the work being made: type a placeholder, delete it, type the actual line, punch in and let parts assemble, then cut wide to the finished thing.
Hand the eye one object and change everything around it or because of it: match cut on an object, grow it into the ground, assemble tiles around a still centre.
Typed chapter lines on flat grounds as the table of contents; keep the caret typing across ground swaps.
Alternate 2-5 s assembly shots with 0.3-0.6 s stutter runs under a fixed caption.
Show actual content full frame before revealing the device it sits on.
Counters step each frame for 9-13 frames; tiles cut on in 1-2 frames without tweens.
Hold the last frame through at least 1 s of silence.
mustChange: branding: names, marks, logos, client-logo row and URL
graphics: renders, illustrations, icons, photographs and page captures
copy: each on-screen term and figure
palette can stay green only if it is the new subject's own colour; otherwise use the subject's palette in the same roles
